text:
sophie: Quick ask — can design produce a compact 'Inference Playbook' mini-visual pack for next week's webinar + inbound routing one-pager? Needs: hero tile, two benchmark microcards (econ vs latency), a one-slide routing matrix, and a sticker-style checklist. Deadline: Tue EOD. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Inference-Playbook (can you create a branch). Please ensure alt-text notes and contrast-safe palette. cc @ben @maria :eyes:
ben: Got it. Who's owning copy and final messaging? Also confirm sizes and how many color variants.
maria: I'll own copy. Will drop two hooks and microcopy in a sec. For variants we want: Brand-blue primary and a high-contrast dark reverse.
jake: FYI routing needs: per-channel CTA examples + UTM examples soops:utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=inference_playbook
sophie: Copy ownership confirmed. Sizes: hero 1200x628 (web), 1080x1080 (social), slide 1920x1080, microcards 800x800, sticker-sheet tiles 360x360. Deliver two message hooks to test A/B.
maria: Hook A: "Serve smarter — cut inference unit cost by up to 2x."
maria: Hook B: "Predictable latency. Predictable cost. Redwood inference."
ben: Nice. Add a small explainer callout that distinguishes Hosted / Dedicated / Private (one-line each). Also need a tiny badge indicating SLA tier for Dedicated examples.
sophie: Good call. Also legal wants a short model-attribution line if we name any community models. @legal-bot please confirm wording.
legal-bot: Reminder: include "Redwood" trademark line: "Redwood Inference and the Redwood logo are trademarks of Redwood Inference, Inc." If any 3rd-party model names are used, add: "Model names are trademarks of their respective owners." Send final export samples for review.
designbot: Automated note: created file branch "playbook-mini-visuals/sophie-5081234567" and added tags #playbook #webinar #mini-tiles.
ben: Export naming convention? Also need SVGs for icons and PNGs for social. Can we get one copy-ready PPTX slide?
sophie: Export specs (please follow exactly):
```
- hero_web: 1200x628 px, PNG, name: playbook_hero_web_v1.png
- hero_social: 1080x1080 px, PNG, name: playbook_hero_social_v1.png
- slide_master: 1920x1080 px, PPTX export, name: playbook_slide_master_v1.pptx
- microcard: 800x800 px, PNG & SVG icons, name: playbook_microcard_<variant>_v1.png
- sticker_sheet: 360x360 px tiles, PNG, transparent bg, name: playbook_sticker_<n>_v1.png
```
(Also include a plain-text alt-text file per asset, e.g., playbook_hero_web_v1_alt.txt)
maria: Copy ready for microcards: short bullets + CTA lines. I'll drop them in Figma comments.
jake: For lead routing slide include: destination buckets (sales-lead, marketing-nurture, product-feedback), sample webhook payload fields, and suggested SLA to respond to hot leads (1 business hour).
sophie: Perfect. Priority: 1) hero web + social, 2) slide master + routing matrix, 3) microcards, 4) sticker checklist. Need first pass in 48 hours so we can QA for the webinar rehearsal.
designbot: First pass frames uploaded to branch. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/Inference-Playbook?node-id=branch-playbook-mini
ben: Accessibility check: confirm color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large display. Also provide keyboard-focus outline for interactive stickers.
sophie: Noted — add contrast callouts in Figma and include alt-text for every tile.
maria: Adding legal copy to comments now.
ben: Will review frames and leave comments. If we can keep assets modular (symbols/components), it'll speed localization.
sophie: Thanks team — if any blocker post here. :rocket:
